limitations: This packet is a screened source-set excerpt, not a complete global inventory.
Point and editorial state locators do not establish whole-feature physical containment.
Scientific claims and public release remain under review.

geometries.method: Approximate editorial locator points place a name in a recognizable region on the OSW equirectangular map. Points are neither observed cores nor endpoints or length measurements. Multi-basin family names have one point per basin and must be split into separate records before quantitative comparison.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

gate_distance_sensitivity.interpretation: Finite gate-perturbation scenarios; not a statistical confidence interval, measured current path, or whole-current length range.
gate_distance_sensitivity.perturbation_basis: OSW editorial sensitivity choice; not source-reported positional uncertainty.
gate_distance_sensitivity.rank_interpretation: Possible position by geographic gate separation within these seven source-gated spans; excludes along-current length and the published-length ranking. Overlap does not establish equal current length.
